headline: Zeal Network Raises 2026 Sales Guidance After Q3 Results
summary: Zeal Network has increased its 2026 sales guidance following the release of its third-quarter financial results.
why: Upward revisions to sales guidance indicate stronger top-line performance than previously anticipated by management.

impacts.name: Zeal Network
impacts.why: Higher sales expectations directly improve the company's valuation outlook.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
